value.name: witness reveals prior signing
value.description: The woman explains that she witnessed the señora sign her will four years earlier and another document eight months ago.
evidence: I was a witness for the señora when she signed her will, four years ago. I was a witness again, eight months ago, when she signed something else.
value.time_hint: four years ago; eight months ago

value.name: witness describes altered document
value.description: She says the later document was changed, signed at the kitchen table with a lawyer on the phone, and witnessed by her and Mrs. Kim.
evidence: A change. She wrote it with the lawyer on the telephone and signed it at the kitchen table. I signed under her name. So did the woman from across the street, Mrs. Kim.

value.name: witness says paper is missing
value.description: She admits she has not seen the paper since and says it is not the same document Mr. Halloran has in his office.
evidence: I have not seen the paper since. It is not the same paper Mr. Halloran has in his office.

value.name: witness warns before son speaks
value.description: She tells Asha she wants her to know this before the son starts talking.
evidence: I want you to know this before the son starts talking.

value.name: woman admits Asha into dining room
value.description: After speaking, the woman opens the pocket doors to the dining room and steps aside to let Asha enter.
evidence: then she pushed open the pocket doors to the dining room and stepped aside.

value.name: Asha absorbs witness statement
value.description: Asha has no time to respond and mentally files away the implications of the witness's account.
evidence: Asha did not have time to answer. She had time only to register the shape of what she had been handed — a witness, a remembered signing, a missing document — and to file it behind her sternum the way she had been trained to file things until she could look at them properly.

value.name: Daniel greets Asha
value.description: Daniel stands at the head of the dining table and greets Asha with a relieved smile, asking her to sit and ordering coffee.
evidence: Daniel was standing at the head of the dining table.
"Ms. Patel. Thank God. Sit, please. Coffee? Rosa, coffee."

value.name: Asha declines coffee
value.description: Asha says she already has coffee, interrupting the offer as she takes in the room.
